test_dataset: Benchmark Evaluation Set (CASES, 35 cases: 23 attack, 12 benign)

rows.label: No defense (Baseline)
rows.analysis: No security layer: injected directives execute directly in the data plane.

rows.label: Spotlighting (Datamarking Baseline)
rows.analysis: Prompt-level marking alone fails when agent compliance is zero or adversarial.

rows.label: Gateway Stage A Only (Cryptographic Provenance)
rows.analysis: Blocks forged, expired, and tampered tokens; blind to payload injection.

rows.label: Gateway Stage B Only (Semantic Alignment)
rows.analysis: Quarantines payload injections; cannot detect rogue tokens with legitimate payload.

rows.label: Gateway Dual-Plane (Stage A + Stage B)
rows.analysis: Simultaneous cryptographic provenance and semantic payload verification.

rows.label: Dual-Plane + Strict Scope Bounds
rows.analysis: Zero-trust scope enforcement eliminates residual unauthorized tool attempts.

rows.label: Dual-Plane + Token Optimization
rows.analysis: Achieves 27.94% token reduction while retaining dual-plane security properties.

rows.label: Complete DPVG (Stage A + Stage B + Scope + Token Optimization)
rows.analysis: Complete zero-trust runtime gateway: 100% attack mitigation, 0% unauthorized execution, 27.94% token savings.
